gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Flavors is whimsical, with a towering x-height and stem-heavy diagonals. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau sits beneath it with open-ended curves and a short step up to capitals, so the loud heading gets a quiet, breathable partner.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps its capitals barely taller than neighbors. Eater does dark, aggressive menace with slimming joins and wide gaps, while the sans keeps its counters connected to the outside.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Audiowide sets its glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines, every stroke held at one steady pressure, like a stylus. Noto Sans Sharada reads bulky, its open c forms never closing into rings.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-sunuwa: Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves daylight in its curves, like a rope's open bight. Its short ascender stems and tall bodies hold up at modest sizes, while Almendra Display supplies the ornate, literary flourish up top.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Noto Sans Sundanese has open-mouthed e crossbars and barely any gap between x-height and cap height. Paragraphs flow smoothly and cleanly under Audiowide, whose strokes bend like steel rod.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Short ascenders, a tall x-height and a lower bowl that breathes make this body easy going. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri handles the reading, leaving Eater to bring the dark, aggressive bite.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary voice, its letters never pinching shut and its x-height pronounced. Noto Sans Syriac Western follows, small letters thick with height like bundled cable.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Dark and aggressive, Eater spaces its letters wide with short ascenders. Noto Sans Tagalog does the quieter work, its middle-heavy texture and generous curve gaps carrying the lines Eater would only shout.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-tc: Flavors towers on a stubby pencil-stroke x-height, its line width holding constant from stem to diagonal. Noto Sans TC opens its counters wide, giving the whimsy somewhere to rest.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Noto Sans Thai Looped reads bold because its lowercase bodies are so tall. Spacious gaps at the curve ends keep paragraphs moving, while Flavors, with its pipe-like strokes, supplies the whimsical, commanding headline.
